messages:
Carla (Infra): Heads up — NexaSupply just updated the RMA on the 8x A800s. They shipped in two pallets but FRA customs flagged 4 units for missing ECC invoice line. Vendor suggests splitting delivery: 4 held in FRA, 4 routed direct to ORD. Need a quick call on acceptance and backfill plan.
Liam - NexaSupply: Hi Carla — correct. Tracking: https://track.nexasupply.com/SHIP12345 (FRA) and https://track.nexasupply.com/SHIP67890 (ORD). We uploaded the missing customs docs this morning but clearance is slow.
Mike (FleetOps): Are the serials on the shipments the same ones we RMA'd? We need serial-level mapping to reconcile warranty credits.
Liam - NexaSupply: Yes — serials match. Pasted below with current status:
```
SHIP12345 (FRA hold):
 - SN-A800-112233 — held
 - SN-A800-112234 — held
 - SN-A800-112235 — held
 - SN-A800-112236 — held

SHIP67890 (ORD):
 - SN-A800-112237 — in transit
 - SN-A800-112238 — in transit
 - SN-A800-112239 — in transit
 - SN-A800-112240 — in transit
```
Carla (Infra): OK. Two questions: 1) can we accept split deliveries (we'll need to stage and tag separately), and 2) will vendor honor same warranty start dates if parts arrive separated?
Liam - NexaSupply: 1) Yes you can accept split. 2) Warranty will be honored per serial from date of delivery, but we can apply a consolidated warranty change note if you want all to be effective from first delivered unit — requires a written waiver.
Julián (Procurement): If warranty is per-delivery then we need a pricing credit for the delay/partial delivery or a service concession. Any restocking or handling fees for the FRA hold?
Liam - NexaSupply: No restocking fee on RMA replacements. For delay we can offer either: a) 10% credit on the 4 FRA units if you accept refurbished replacements immediately, or b) free 2-week loaners (A6000) while FRA clears, then swap when new A800s arrive. Fresh A800 stock lead time is ~6–8 weeks if we can't clear customs.
Mike (FleetOps): We do have 4 A6000 spares in MIA that could be pushed to ORD as temporary backfill. Monthly delta cost (perf) is roughly $6k in cloud-equivalent burn; internal ops cost minimal. I can stage them if procurement signs off.
Carla (Infra): I prefer loaners to refurbished credits — keeps performance predictable. Mike, please confirm cold-swap plan and cross-tagging process.
Mike (FleetOps): Will do. Plan: receive 4x A800s at ORD, hot-swap into the cluster, label loaners with "TEMP-LOAN" tag, and schedule swapback within 14 days unless we extend. I'll script inventory updates.
RMA-Bot: Automated update — customs docs accepted for SHIP12345 at 12:07 UTC; estimated clearance 18–36 hrs. Tracking: FRA: SHIP12345 -> clearing.
Carla (Infra): Great — that shortens it. Julián, is vendor loaner covered under existing PO terms or do we need an amendment?
Julián (Procurement): Our PO doesn't explicitly cover extended loaners. I'll request a PO amendment for the loaner clause and add a fallback credit term if FRA hold > 14 days. Liam, can you send a one-line confirmation with loaner terms and contact for escalation? (we need legal-friendly language).
Liam - NexaSupply: Will send formal addendum in email in next 30 min. TL;DR in chat: 2-week A6000 loaners at no charge; after 14 days a prorated rental fee of $350/day/unit until replacement arrival; warranty on replacements unchanged; refurbished option available with 10% unit credit. Escalation: ops@nexasupply.com (SLA 2h).
Carla (Infra): Approved to accept split delivery and loaners per the terms above. Mike proceed with staging and swaps. Julián please push the PO amend and add the prorated clause.
Julián (Procurement): On it — drafting amendment now. Will cc legal and ops.
Liam - NexaSupply: Thanks — will push customs follow-up and share final tracking once FRA clears.
Carla (Infra): Thanks all. I'll mark this thread for ops-runbook updates (we should add split-delivery + loaner flow to the RMA playbook). :thumbsup:
Mike (FleetOps): Noted — I'll add the swap script and tag mapping to runbook after the swap.
Carla (Infra): Closing loop when SHIP12345 clears. :pray:
